name: Lacuna
description: A gravity-shifting tunnel sustained by nurturing magic that leads from Mirrodin down to the Furnace Layer.

timeline.summary: Nahiri discovers the wound on her neck has become a slick Phyrexian protrusion and realizes she is infected, but decides to conceal it.
timeline.quote: She pulled her hand away with a hiss of dismay

timeline.summary: Nahiri resolves to hide the infection and get her companions as far as she can before she succumbs.
timeline.quote: it was best to get them as far as she possibly could before she succumbed

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Kaya descend through the lacuna with Kaya carrying a stray tanuki-shaped robot.
timeline.quote: From there, they had continued toward the white lacuna

pages_say.description: A gravity-warping tunnel the Mirrans captured that carries travelers down to the Furnace Layer.
